headlines.text: Rewind to 2023, when the FTW Title found a new home as Jack Perry vs. Hook battled it out, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.44 ? ending the champion's reign at 3 defenses. Burying his "Jungle Boy" persona in the desert and switching his entrance to Beethoven's Symphony No. 5, Jack Perry ended Hook's undefeated streak with a title-belt shot behind the referee's back to become FTW Champion.
On a Saturday in 2025, back when Action Andretti returned to the fold after 2 months away, appearing on Collision.
Back on this day in 2024, Penta El Zero M returned to the fold after 6 weeks away, appearing on Rampage.

secondaries.text: That Wednesday in 2023, Kota Ibushi didn't ease in ? their first AEW match was the main event in a Blood And Guts match against Castagnoli, Moxley & Yuta vs. The Young Bucks vs. Adam Page vs. Kenny Omega vs. Matt Jackson vs. Nick Jackson vs. Claudio Castagnoli vs. Jon Moxley vs. Wheeler Yuta vs. Konosuke Takeshita vs. PAC, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.16 ? a hard-hitting, high-quality battle. PAC dropped out mid-match by flipping off his own partners and walking away, while Don Callis pulled Takeshita from the cage entirely, as the returning Kota Ibushi helped The Golden Elite outlast the Blackpool Combat Club.
On this day in 2025, Rush returned to the fold after 6 weeks away, appearing on Collision.

On a Saturday in 2025, back when JetSpeed & Dorada vs. JetSpeed vs. Bandido vs. Kevin Knight vs. Mike Bailey vs. Mascara Dorada vs. Hechicero vs. Josh Alexander vs. Lance Archer vs. Rocky Romero headlined Collision, rated 7.52 ? a well-worked match.
